title: Ethionamide (and prothionamide)
dek: A thioamide prodrug, EthA-activated, InhA-targeted — INH’s cousin. GI misery, hypothyroidism, teratogenicity. Still in the 2022 9-month unless swapped for 2 months of LZD.
story: Ethionamide is a structural cousin of INH: EthA (monooxygenase) activates it; the adduct hits InhA. inhA promoter mutants are cross-R. katG S315T often spares ETH. Prothionamide is the same idea with slightly different GI lore.
WHO 2022 9-month oral still lists Eto in the intensive phase, replaceable by 2 months of linezolid 600 mg — and that replacement is the pregnancy path. ETH is not in BPaLM. It is not TPT.

Host: nausea that sinks adherence, metallic taste, hepatitis, and hypothyroidism (especially with PAS). Give pyridoxine. Do not combine with INH high-dose as two InhA drugs and call them two mechanisms.
deep: ethA frameshifts prevent activation — ETH-R with intact InhA and often intact INH (if katG WT).
ethR overexpression can reduce ethA. Catalogue-grade.
Pediatric TBM recipes sometimes use ETH for CSF instead of EMB. That is a different, site-specific job.

visual.caption: ETH parallels INH at InhA after a different activator. Promoter inhA is the shared-resistance join. Pregnancy prefers the LZD swap.

steps.title: Eto is compromised
steps.body: Shared InhA overexpression. Swap to the LZD 2-month variant even if not pregnant.

steps.title: High-dose INH is the remaining INH-class question
steps.body: Low-level INH-R: some recipes still count Hh. Do not also count Eto.

steps.title: Thyroid and nausea
steps.body: If Eto stays for some reason, TSH and antiemetics are part of DST-adjacent care.

example.takeaway: ETH is InhA after EthA — inhA promoter kills it.
